_note: Content of the collection pages of the eight lines, read by scripts/build_collections.py, which also writes one page per piece. The fragrance page of line 1 (Slate) is fragrance.html, written by hand. Names, prices and copy are the concept of a fictional house. Dot positions are percentages of the look photograph.

collections.name: Iron Court

campaign.alt: Three models in a concrete hall under one spotlight: a floor-length coat of silver paillettes, a silver chest plate under a camel wool cape, and a sculpted black satin gown with a train

collections.description: Iron Court is line 01 of eight in the Vanth Autumn Winter 2026 season. Armour cut as eveningwear, in silver, black satin and camel wool.
collections.intro: Armour, cut as eveningwear. Silver, black satin and camel wool, built for a hall of raw concrete.

looks.alt: A woman with a short black fringe climbs a concrete staircase in a black satin gown with a draped skirt and a train lined in dark gold, looking back over her shoulder
looks.title: The Court Gown
looks.body: A halter bodice in black duchesse satin and a skirt draped by hand at the hips. The train carries a dark gold lining that only shows when she moves. Black satin gloves reach above the elbow.

photo.alt: The Opera Glove: a pair of long black satin gloves laid side by side on a slab of black stone

looks.alt: A model with slicked blond hair stands in a tall concrete doorway in a floor-length coat of silver paillettes, one hand on the door frame, light coming from behind
looks.title: The Scale Coat
looks.body: Thousands of silver paillettes sewn one over the other, from a funnel collar to the floor. The coat catches the light like the skin of a fish.

looks.alt: A bearded man sits on a concrete block in a black suit with a polished silver chest plate and a camel wool cape pooling on the floor
looks.title: Plate and Cape
looks.body: A chest plate in polished silver over black tailoring, under a cape of double-faced camel wool that reaches the floor.

photo.alt: The Chest Plate on a black dress form: a breastplate of polished silver shaped to the torso
The Camel Cape on a black dress form: a camel wool cape with a wide collar that falls to the floor

pieces.alt: The Court Gown on a black dress form: black satin with a halter neck, a draped skirt and a train lined in dark gold
pieces.name: The Court Gown

pieces.alt: The Scale Coat on a black dress form: a floor-length coat covered in silver paillettes with a funnel collar
pieces.name: The Scale Coat

pieces.alt: The Chest Plate and the Camel Cape on a black dress form: polished silver armour under a camel wool cape that falls to the floor
pieces.name: Plate and Cape

pieces.alt: The Box Bag on a concrete block: a structured top handle bag in black leather with steel hardware
pieces.name: The Box Bag

scent.alt: The Slate bottle, smoked black glass with a brushed steel cap, on a concrete block beside a fold of black satin and a few silver paillettes
scent.notes: Black pepper, cold steel and smoked leather, in smoked glass with a steel cap.
scent.lead: Eau de parfum for the hour before you leave.

collections.name: Night Office

campaign.alt: Four models in a theatre box in violet taffeta, bottle green velvet, a beaded coat with a magenta sash and black sequins

collections.intro: Evening clothes for the hours after work. A violet gown for the opera, a velvet suit for the gallery and a beaded coat for the long dinner.
